title: The Restaurant at the End of the Universe
author: Douglas Adams
summary: The second Hitchhiker's book sends its stranded travellers off to a restaurant where diners watch the end of the universe over dinner. It also adds a ruler, a missing planet and a lot of absurd detours.
readIf: you have read the first book and want more of the same silly, quotable cosmic comedy.
skipIf: you have not read the first book, as the story picks up directly and assumes you know the cast.

pairings.reason: Another funny, clever story about the end of the world, written with the same affectionate silliness.
A fantasy answer to this book's style, with equally ridiculous creatures and deadpan footnotes.
A more modern, lighter-hearted space adventure that mixes science-fiction ideas with jokes.
